instruction: I'd like to change the volume slider to a blue color theme in VLC. A cooler color scheme would match better with my overall desktop theme and provide better visual contrast.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the VLC volume slider to a blue color scheme. Uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric function with type='match' to verify the qt-slider-colours setting matches the expected blue color pattern (50;100;200;30;80;180;40;120;220;45;90;190) representing 4 RGB colors in bluish tones.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) containing qt-slider-colours setting
Metric function check_qt_slider_colours correctly reads config file and extracts qt-slider-colours value with proper default handling
Metric performs exact string match comparison (type='match') which is appropriate for this configuration setting
Expected value '50;100;200;30;80;180;40;120;220;45;90;190' represents 4 blue-ish RGB colors (e.g., RGB(50,100,200), RGB(30,80,180)) matching the instruction requirement for blue color theme
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are loaded before verification
Complete coverage: instruction asks to change volume slider to blue, evaluator checks the qt-slider-colours setting
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config file path → metric reads file and checks qt-slider-colours value → compares against expected blue color pattern
